purpose: Teach: 小切手/インターンシップ/本案/公言/借り入れ/呼び名/生年月日/ベーシック

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 小切手の発行手続きを社員に説明しましょう
lines.en: Let's walk the staff through the check-issuing procedure.
lines.style: Crisp, efficient opening. Calm authority—not rushed, but no wasted motion. Clear directive tone. Professional ease.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。インターンシップ生の受け入れ体制を整えました
lines.en: Yes. I've set up the framework for bringing interns on board.
lines.style: Steady agreement. Slight uptick of pride on accomplishment. Measured pace. Reporting readiness without overselling.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本案については慎重に決定しましょう
lines.en: We should decide on this proposal carefully.
lines.style: Measured weight on 'carefully.' Calm, deliberate pacing. The kind of director who slows down before important decisions. Eye-level and thoughtful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社長が新方針を公言する記者会見を準備します
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare the press conference for the president's announcement of the new policy.
lines.style: Efficient commitment. Slight warmth underneath—he's already thinking through the logistics. Brisk but not pressured. Reliable tempo.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 短期の借り入れも検討しておきましょう
lines.en: Let's also look into short-term financing options.
lines.style: Another directive, but less weighty than the last. Practical, forward-thinking pace. Smooth transition between points. Assured.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品の呼び名は親しみやすくしたいですね
lines.en: Yes. I think we should make the new product's name more approachable.
lines.style: Engaged suggestion. A beat of consideration before speaking. Warm but professional. Sees the strategic side. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員の生年月日は個人情報として厳重に管理しましょう
lines.en: We need to manage employee birth dates as strictly confidential personal information.
lines.style: Firm directness on 'strictly.' Clear compliance tone without lecturing. Even pacing. No room for interpretation—protective.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ベーシックなマナー研修を全員に実施します
lines.en: Yes. I'll roll out basic etiquette training to everyone.
lines.style: Final agreement. Closing tone—matter-of-fact and decisive. Slight nod feel in the voice. Wrapping up cleanly, ready to move on.
